name: Progresso Hearty Tomato Soup (Acidic Acid WARNING)
whyItWorks: Contains chunky diced tomatoes with intact skins and seeds suspended in concentrated tomato puree. The coarse skins and concentrated acidity can cause heartburn and intestinal burning in active IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid chunky tomato soups. If craving tomato flavor, stick to smooth condensed soup well-diluted.
